entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I hope you can help me. I'm just so confused. I have a VeloBand GPS Tracker I need to return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-29-B. I'm just... I'm really worried it's too late to send it back.

Okay, I'm pulling up order VF886-29-B now. I see it was delivered 27 days ago. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, there's nothing wrong with it, I just don't like it. I was reading the return policy online and it was all very overwhelming. It talked about hygiene and I got worried. Can't you just help me?

I understand completely, and I can definitely clarify that for you. I see why that would be confusing. We did recently introduce a stricter policy for some of our newer health-monitoring devices for sanitation reasons.
However, let me check the exact terms for your VeloBand GPS Tracker... Okay, good news. Your particular item falls under our standard 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? So it's not a problem? That's such a relief!
Not a problem at all. I have just authorized the return for you and emailed a pre-paid shipping label. Just pack it up in the original box and you'll be all set.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac. You've made this so much easier for me.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
